# `get_source_version`

Read one manifest-authorised immutable ADT source version. The UTF-8 response is bounded and is never silently truncated.

Defined in [`packages/adt-mcp/src/lib/tools/get-source-version.ts`](https://github.com/abapify/adt-cli/blob/main/packages/adt-mcp/src/lib/tools/get-source-version.ts).

## Input schema

| Parameter          | Type      | Required | Description                                                                            |
| ------------------ | --------- | -------- | -------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `baseUrl`          | `string`  | no       | SAP system base URL (e.g. https://host:8000)                                           |
| `client`           | `string`  | no       | SAP client number                                                                      |
| `username`         | `string`  | no       | Username for basic auth                                                                |
| `password`         | `string`  | no       | Password for basic auth                                                                |
| `systemId`         | `string`  | no       | Logical system id (resolved via multi-system config or ~/.adt sessions)                |
| `sourceCapability` | `string`  | no       | Opaque capability returned by cts_transport_source_manifest                            |
| `uri`              | `string`  | no       | Direct server-relative ADT URI (must start with /sap/bc/adt/); prefer sourceCapability |
| `maxBytes`         | `integer` | no       | Maximum UTF-8 response size in bytes (default 1048576, hard cap 2097152)               |

## Output

The tool returns a single text content item whose body is a JSON-serialised object (`content[0].text`). On error, the response has `isError: true` and a human-readable message.

```json
{
  "content": [{ "type": "text", "text": "<JSON.stringify(result, null, 2)>" }]
}
```

On success `result` contains `bytes` and `source`. See the source for field details.
